name: print-social-purple-neon-silhouette-summit-poster-with-grid-and-reflection
title: Purple Neon Summit Poster with Silhouettes
whatItIs: A black and purple event poster with a grid-lit top, a logo, glowing white heavy title 'MEN'S TALK SUMMIT' with a 2.0 circle, a tagline, and a row of seated silhouettes against glowing purple windows with reflections, and the date, 'More details soon' and a circled 11AM.
whatItMeans: Silhouettes against purple light suggest conversation and depth, and the glowing title gives it gravitas.
techniques: Glowing white heavy title on black
Grid lines fading down from the top

vocabulary.definition: People shown only as dark shapes against a light.
Lettering with a soft outer glow.
A mirrored image of elements on a glossy floor.
